name: de.mygn/events
title: mygn & rundown.city – curated city events
description: Curated, ad-free city events in Germany and the US: tonight, weekend, free, family. Read-only.

tools.name: list_hubs
tools.description: List the cities (hubs) covered by mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco, New York City): hub slug, display label, timezone and the website of the hub. Pass the slug as hub to the other tools. The hub website is the source to cite.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the event categories one hub of mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco, New York City) currently has, each with its slug, display label (in the hub's language) and a one-line definition. The slugs are the values for the categories filter of search_events. Typical slugs: party, concert, culture, show, family, food, sport, market, cruise, quiz, tours, other; an event has exactly one.

hub.description: Hub (city): one of hamburg, muenchen, oldenburg, san-francisco, new-york-city; names and abbreviations work too ('Munich', 'MUC', 'HH', 'OL', 'SF', 'SFO', 'Bay Area', 'NYC', 'New York'), any case.

tools.name: get_day_overview
tools.description: How busy one day is in a hub of mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco, New York City): events per category, free and verified-location counts, whether the day is quiet, normal or busy against the same kind of day in the next 14 days (unknown further out) and top_curated, our editorial picks (occurrence_id, title, starts_at; empty while nothing is rated). An event counts once per day. Pass when (today, tonight, tomorrow) or date; time_from counts only events starting at or after it (busyness stays day-level). Use it for 'is there a lot on this Saturday' before search_events.

hub.description: Hub (city): one of hamburg, muenchen, oldenburg, san-francisco, new-york-city; names and abbreviations work too ('Munich', 'MUC', 'HH', 'OL', 'SF', 'SFO', 'Bay Area', 'NYC', 'New York'), any case.

date.description: The day in the hub's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD. Required unless when is given.

time_from.description: Count only events that start at or after this time of day, HH:MM in the hub's local time (24 hours), for 'tonight'. Events without a known start time (all_day, time_unknown) are not counted.

when.description: today, tonight (today from 18:00 unless time_from is given), tomorrow, in the hub's local calendar; echoed as resolved. Replaces date (naming both is an error).

verbose.description: true adds the internal fields (curation score and flags, signals, series_kind, kind, long_running) that are left out by default.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find things to do in Hamburg, München, Oldenburg, San Francisco or New York City for a date range: date ideas, tonight, this weekend, free events, family outings, concerts, parties, exhibitions, markets. Use this when a user asks 'what can I do...', 'was ist los...', 'wohin heute Abend'. For best picks use sort='curation'. query matches keywords (e.g. 'jazz', 'Flohmarkt'); weekday, time and free words set the window and free_only; total is 0 when query_fallback. Instead of dates pass when (today, tonight, this_weekend ...). Items: occurrence_id (for get_event), title, category, starts_at (hub local time), all_day, time_unknown (true: no showtime known, never show 00:00), venue, price_text, price_known (false: price not known, do not assume free), age_min, audience, tags, share_url (the event's own page on our site or, without one, our hub page, the source to cite) from mygn.de or rundown.city.

hub.description: Hub (city): one of hamburg, muenchen, oldenburg, san-francisco, new-york-city; names and abbreviations work too ('Munich', 'MUC', 'HH', 'OL', 'SF', 'SFO', 'Bay Area', 'NYC', 'New York'), any case.

date_from.description: First day, inclusive, in the hub's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD; not earlier than yesterday. At most 31 days to date_to, which is at most 31 days from today. Required unless when or query is given (a weekday or time word in query sets it, else the next 7 days).

date_to.description: Last day, inclusive, in the hub's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD; not before date_from. Required whenever date_from is.

when.description: today, tonight (today from 18:00 unless time_from is given), tomorrow, this_weekend (the coming Saturday and Sunday; on a weekend day the current one, on a Sunday that day alone), next_weekend (the one after), in the hub's local calendar; echoed as resolved. Replaces date_from and date_to (naming both is an error).

categories.description: Keep only events of these category slugs (see list_categories); use ['family'] for children's and family events. An unknown slug is an error.

free_only.description: true keeps only events known to be free.

venue.description: Venue name or town; matches the venue name as shown in results, so a town name keeps every venue in that town.

query.description: Keywords for title and summary, every word must match (compounds split, plurals read). Never a mood like 'romantic'. Filler, pronoun and time words (date, ideas, things to do, ich, ...) are ignored; time words (heute abend, tomorrow, am Wochenende) set the window like when, without dates, when, a weekday or group_by 'event'; night/abend alone is tonight, else a keyword; nothing but fillers and no dates: refused (use when), with dates: query_dropped. A weekday (Samstag, Friday night) sets the window without dates, else narrows the given one (not with group_by 'event'). German free words (kostenlos, gratis, eintritt frei) always set free_only; English free only in a sentence or alone, not before a capitalised word (Free Jazz). Without dates the next 7 days are searched. Kinder, Kids, Familie and family list family events first instead of filtering. If nothing matches, unrelated curated picks of the same filters answer, with query_fallback true: tell the user nothing matched (not with group_by 'event').

max_age_min.description: Keep events with no stated minimum age or one of at most this age; 0 means no age restriction stated.

family_friendly.description: true keeps events suitable for parents with children (audience.family true; without an audience rating: category family without a minimum age of 16 or more); false keeps the rest.

time_from.description: Keep events that start at or after this time of day, HH:MM in the hub's local time (24 hours), for 'tonight'. Events without a known start time (all_day, time_unknown) are dropped. With a time_to before time_from the range wraps past midnight.

time_to.description: Keep events that start at or before this time of day, HH:MM in the hub's local time (24 hours).

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 50 (clamped); default 25. total counts items.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read on.

sort.description: 'time' lists chronologically (default), events without a known start time at the end of their day; 'curation' lists the editorially ranked best first (equal ranks in time order). 'start' and 'date' are accepted as 'time'.

group_by.description: 'occurrence': an event once per day, its time slots in slots (the item itself is the first slot). 'event': each event once for the whole range, with first_starts_at, last_starts_at, occurrences_count of its matching dates (filters apply first; with sort 'curation' placed by its best match) and its season_first_starts_at, season_last_starts_at, season_occurrences_count (all its upcoming dates up to 31 days ahead, ignoring the filters) with starts_before_range and continues_after_range. Default: 'event' when sort is 'curation' and the range spans more than one day, else 'occurrence'. Use 'event' for 'when does X open'.

verbose.description: true adds the internal fields (curation score and flags, signals, series_kind, kind, long_running) that are left out by default.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: The full record of one event occurrence (occurrence_id from search_events) in a hub of mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco, New York City): summary, start and end, venue with address and coordinates, price_text and price_known (false: price not known, do not assume free), age_min, audience, url (the organiser's page, for tickets and opening details), the link to this event's own page on our site or, without one, our hub page (share_url), brand, attribution_url (the hub page to cite as the source) and the next 20 other dates (siblings; siblings_truncated true when there are more). Internal fields (signals, series_kind, kind, title_override) only with verbose true. all_day true: spans the whole day. time_unknown true: starts_at is only a date anchor, never show 00:00. series_continues true: the listed dates stop only where our look-ahead stops, so it likely runs on; never say it ends after the last listed date.

occurrence_id.description: The occurrence_id of an item from search_events.

verbose.description: true adds the internal fields (curation score and flags, signals, series_kind, kind, long_running) that are left out by default.
